svg.title: Figure A-6: hazard sheet H-02 · uncommanded motion near people
svg.desc: The hazard sheet of H-02 · uncommanded motion near people: the hazardous event, the S, F and P ratings in words with the required Performance Level d, the measures of the three ISO 12100 steps coloured by whether each exists today, the residual-risk class and its text, and the gap and scenario references.
